int_name: W ALLEGHENY AVE & N STILLMAN ST

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and traffic control devices, despite a warning sign indicating a crossing ahead. The wide, unmarked asphalt and parked cars along the side street create an environment where pedestrian priority is not clearly established.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: A pedestrian crossing sign is present on the left, but there are no corresponding pavement markings to define a safe crossing zone.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the side street can block the view of pedestrians, particularly children, attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly delineate the pedestrian path and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they step into the street.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate vehicle movement and provide safer gaps for pedestrians to cross.

result.summary: The street features a residential environment with sidewalks and a marked bike lane, but lacks visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian-specific safety infrastructure at the intersection. The wide roadway and lack of physical separation between modes may encourage higher vehicle speeds and increase crossing risk.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space or priority.

hazards.name: Wide roadway width
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway design with minimal vertical elements may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing painted bike lane with physical protection to better separate cyclists from motor vehicle traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, unmarked intersection with no visible crossing infrastructure or traffic controls. Pedestrians must navigate a significant crossing distance across multiple lanes of traffic with potential sightline obstructions from vehicles parked close to the corners.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this wide intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated path or priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the corner of the mini market block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks and a dedicated bike lane, but lacks marked crosswalks or pedestrian-specific safety infrastructure. The wide roadway and parked vehicles along the curb create significant crossing exposure and visibility challenges for pedestrians.
